title: Attestation FastPath: evidence-minimizing attestation bundles + pricing experiment for mid-market
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise buyers frequently stall during procurement while we assemble CAIQ/SIG evidence and custom attestations. Sales and Solutions Engineering spend multiple days to curate docs for each customer. This increases time-to-close and creates manual support load.

Goal: Create an "Attestation FastPath" productized offering that: 1) provides curated, minimal evidence bundles for common enterprise risk profiles, 2) exposes a self-serve exporter for SIG/CAIQ and attestation statements, and 3) experiments with a two-tier pricing/packaging model (Free baseline + Paid FastPath add-on) to reduce sales friction and measure revenue impact.

Scope:
- Define 3 evidence bundle templates (Startup, Mid-market, Regulated) mapping to a short checklist of required artifacts (CAIQ answers, encryption KMS notes, data residency statement, SOC/ISO links where available).
- Build an automated CAIQ export that compiles answers + linked artifacts into a download and a sharable link.
- Create a paid FastPath add-on that includes a pre-signed attestation letter, expedited evidence assembly (48h SLA), and an audit-ready evidence bundle.
- Update sales enablement playbook and add a new Console flow for requesting/exporting attestation bundles.

Why unique: Unlike previous efforts that focused solely on collecting documentation or bundling existing attestations, this initiative frames attestations as a product add-on with clear pricing/levers (free vs fast SLA vs premium audit support) and couples it to measurable GTM metrics (time-to-close, attach rate, and ARR impact).
success_metrics: Reduce average time-to-close for mid-market deals from 28 days to <=18 days
Attach rate of FastPath add-on >= 12% for qualified opportunities within 3 months
Decrease Security-support escalations related to CAIQ from 3/week to <=1/week
acceptance_criteria: Three evidence bundle templates documented and approved by Security (Confluence link)
CAIQ export implementation merged behind feature flag (GitHub PR #11234)
Console flow for request/export available in staging and validated with solutions engineering playbook
Pricing is defined and billable via Stripe/contracting for add-on tier

risks_and_tradeoffs: Risk: Over-promising evidence completeness could create legal exposure—we will limit attestation wording and surface references to artifacts rather than absolute guarantees.
Trade-off: Automated exporter may not capture bespoke controls for regulated customers; heavyweight bespoke onboarding will remain an available paid service.
Risk: Offering a paid SKU increases expectations for SLA-backed delivery; we must instrument routing and capacity to hit 48h promise or set realistic SLA tiers.

Trade-off: Minimizing evidence bundle size speeds procurement but may push support burden to Security/SE if customers request expanded artifacts; include an escalation path and clear pricing for audit support.
